name: sample-external-incidents-2025 (illustrative third-party-style corpus)
_note: A small labeled corpus in cachly's portable bench format. Replace with a real third-party-labeled set to reproduce the lift claim externally. Each query's `relevant` lists the topic(s) that actually solve it; text-similar failed/unverified lessons act as distractors.

lessons.what_worked: Raised the container memory limit to 2Gi and shortened Prometheus retention to 7d; the pod stopped getting OOMKilled during WAL replay.
lessons.what_failed: Just restarting the pod — it OOMKilled again within minutes.
Assumed the restarting pod was a memory leak and rolled back the deployment; restarts continued because the real cause was the memory limit, not the app.

lessons.what_worked: Set the pool max to 20 and added a 30s idle timeout; switched the ORM to release connections after each request. Pool exhaustion under load disappeared.
lessons.what_failed: Bumping max connections to 500 only moved the bottleneck to the database server.

lessons.what_worked: Added an index on user_id which helped one query, but connection errors under load persisted.
Automated cert renewal with certbot in a daily cron and reloaded nginx via a deploy hook; expiry incidents stopped.
lessons.what_failed: Manually renewing certs — someone always forgot and prod went down.

lessons.what_worked: Added explicit waits for network idle and pinned the browser version in CI; flaky e2e timeout failures dropped to near zero.
lessons.what_failed: Blindly increasing the global timeout just made the suite slower without fixing flakiness.
Increased the e2e timeout from 30s to 120s hoping flaky tests would pass; the suite got 4x slower and still flaked.

lessons.what_worked: Added a 60s leeway to JWT exp validation and synced server clocks with NTP; intermittent 401s for valid tokens stopped.
lessons.what_failed: Disabling expiry checks entirely — fixed the 401s but opened a security hole.

lessons.what_worked: Added a per-key mutex (single-flight) plus jittered TTLs so cache misses don't all hit the DB at once; the thundering-herd spikes vanished.
lessons.what_failed: Simply increasing the cache TTL hid the problem until the next mass-expiry spike.

lessons.what_worked: Made migrations backward-compatible (expand/contract) and split schema changes across two deploys; rollbacks stopped deadlocking on migration locks.
lessons.what_failed: Rolling back with a destructive down-migration locked the table and took prod down.

queries.query: kubernetes pod keeps restarting out of memory
database connection pool exhausted under load
tls certificate expired in production renewal
flaky end to end tests timing out in ci
cache misses overwhelming the database thundering herd
deploy rollback deadlock on migration lock
